title: weingaertneria deschampsioides
intro: Weingaertneria deschampsioides, commonly known as Huangqi, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory properties, and is believed to provide various health benefits, including reducing stress and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Huangqi include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of Huangqi include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties.
